digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर दुनिया की अगुवाई है, हार्वर्ड के वैज्ञानिकों ने लैब में विकसित किए दिमाग के सेल्स, 7 साल तक फले-फूले मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही अमेरिका से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?
articles.summary: Dans cet épisode d’Afrique 360°, Enrica Picco et Rinaldo Depagne reçoivent Frédéric Manantsoa Lai, coordinateur des urgences pour Médecins Sans Frontières, et Onesphore Sematumba, analyste senior pour la République démocratique du Congo et le Burundi à Crisis Group, pour parler de l’épidémie d’Ebola en RDC et de ses conséquences sur la population congolaise, déjà marquée par des années de conflit.

articles.title: Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?
articles.summary: İkinci Dünya Savaşı sonrasında şekillenen uluslararası düzen giderek çözülürken, Ankara ve diğer Avrupa başkentlerindeki yetkililer güvenlik alanında birlikte hareket etmedikleri takdirde ciddi risklerle karşı karşıya kalacaklarının giderek daha fazla farkına varıyor. Tehdit algıları farklılık gösterse de, pragmatik ve esnek iş birliği yolları geliştirmeleri hâlâ mümkün. Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?

articles.title: Syria Kurdish women fighters discuss merger with interior ministry
articles.summary: The announcement came two days after the head of Kurdish fighters in Syria, Mazloum Abdi, announced the dissolution of the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF). which includes the YPJ. under an agreement with Damascus Syria Kurdish women fighters discuss merger with interior ministry.

articles.title: Why is Instagram’s design under fire in massive child safety case
articles.summary: Meta has agreed to a settlement worth up to $16.68 billion in a case alleging Facebook and Instagram were designed to keep children engaged and collect their data. The company denies wrongdoing, but the agreement could bring major changes for teenage users across the United States. Why is Instagram’s design under fire in massive child safety case.

articles.title: Ukrainian Drone Spots SOS, Sparking 3-Day Rescue From Frontline Village
articles.summary: After a Ukrainian drone operator spotted an SOS sign outside a destroyed home in the Donetsk region, a three-day rescue mission was launched to save a couple who were the last remaining residents of their frontline village. Ukrainian Drone Spots SOS, Sparking 3-Day Rescue From Frontline Village.

articles.title: At least 359 people dead in Nepal flood; rescue operations underway
articles.summary: Government issues fresh flood alert after satellite imagery shows that a lake has formed upstream of Bhotekoshi River; “towns were wiped out in a span of a couple of hours,” says Foreign Minister Shishir Khamal At least 359 people dead in Nepal flood; rescue operations underway.

articles.title: UN warns of growing civilian risks as military activity continues
articles.summary: Damaged roads, disrupted services and ongoing military activity continue to put civilians at risk in south Lebanon as strikes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah continue, according to the UN’s peacekeeping mission in the country (UNIFIL). UN warns of growing civilian risks as military activity continues.

Shock and devastation remain, a day after Himalayan flood disaster.

articles.title: Latvia’s ‘Weekend Warriors’ Prepare For Potential Russian Threat
articles.summary: Latvia’s volunteer National Guard, the Zemessardze, has taken on a growing role in the country’s defense since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Baltic States Arm For Russian Threat As Leaked Letter Shows Growing Fears.

articles.title: Life-Saving Resource Or Political Weapon?
articles.summary: The Ibar River feeds Lake Gazivode, providing drinking water as well as water for crop irrigation and cooling power plants across Kosovo. articles.title: More health workers, stronger systems: Africa’s new ambitious goal
articles.summary: Facing a projected shortage of more than six million health professionals by 2035, African countries are stepping up efforts to strengthen their workforce, with a new decade-long plan announced on Wednesday during a meeting of health ministers in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. More health workers, stronger systems: Africa’s new ambitious goal.

articles.title: CIA Director Ratcliffe's Surprise Moscow Trip Raises Questions Over Russia, Ukraine, Iran
articles.summary: CIA Director John Ratcliffe made an unannounced visit to Moscow on August 25, US officials confirmed to RFE/RL, a rare trip that comes as Washington’s efforts to end Russia’s war against Ukraine have stalled and tensions over Moscow’s relationship with Iran have intensified. CIA Director Ratcliffe's Surprise Moscow Trip Raises Questions Over Russia, Ukraine, Iran.

articles.summary: Volunteers in the Penza region town of Bashmakovo have formed patrols to prevent military recruiters from taking local men to fight in Ukraine, an unusual grassroots response to the Russian state’s increasingly aggressive efforts to find troops for the war Aggressive Recruiters Are Rounding Up Russians To Fight In Ukraine. articles.title: Russian Children Reportedly Beaten, Injured At Patriotic Camp Funded By Kremlin
articles.summary: Children at a Russian Orthodox Christian military-patriotic camp have allegedly been beaten and subjected to other physical punishment, prompting a criminal investigation and scrutiny of an organization that has received millions of rubles in state grants. Russian Children Reportedly Beaten, Injured At Patriotic Camp Funded By Kremlin.

articles.title: Haiti ramps up the fight against gangs in the capital, but violence spreads elsewhere
articles.summary: The killings in Kenscoff began late Sunday, when armed men descended on the farming community in the hills overlooking Haiti’s capital, setting homes ablaze and attacking residents. By Monday, bodies lay in the streets and survivors were searching for missing relatives. Haiti ramps up the fight against gangs in the capital, but violence spreads elsewhere.

articles.title: As wars spread, the global food system unravels
articles.summary: A family with four children abandoned its farm in Somalia after armed groups arrived and demanded payments for the right to continue cultivating the land. They walked roughly 100 kilometers to a displacement camp. One of the children died along the way. As wars spread, the global food system unravels.

articles.summary: विमान हादसों के बढ़ते मामले चिंता का विषय है। दुनियाभर में आए दिन कहीं न कहीं विमान हादसों के मामले देखने को मिलते हैं। पिछले दो साल में विमान क्रैश (Plane Crash) होने के मामलों में इजाफा हुआ है। अब ऐसा ही एक मामला अमेरिका (United States of America) के अलास्का (Alaska) राज्य में सामने आया है।

articles.summary: इटली में ब्लू क्रैब ने समंदर के किनारे भारी तबाही मचाई है. इससे करीब 200 मिलियन यूरो का नुकसान हुआ है. अब इटली के साइंटिस्ट्स ने इसका एक अनोखा तोड़ निकाला है. उन्होंने समंदर में एक लाख 30 हजार से ज्यादा ऑक्टोपस छोड़े हैं. ये ऑक्टोपस बड़े होकर इन खतरनाक क्रैब्स का शिकार करेंगे. पानी के अंदर महायुद्ध की तैयारी, नीले केकड़ों के खिलाफ इटली ने क्यों उतारी 1.30 लाख बेबी ऑक्टोपस की।
